description: One-pass page editor. Delete pages, rotate specific pages by 90°/180°/270°, and reorder the result — in any combination. Page numbers in `rotate` refer to the SOURCE PDF; `reorder` refers to post-delete positions.

delete.description: Pages to delete, 1-based, comma/range form. Example: "1,3,5-7". Applied BEFORE rotate and reorder.

outputPath.description: Absolute path to write the result to.

path.description: Absolute path to the source PDF.

reorder.description: New page order, expressed as 1-based positions in the post-delete output. Example: [3,1,2] puts page 3 first. Must be a permutation of all surviving pages.

rotate.description: Per-page absolute rotations applied to pages that survive the delete step. Page numbers refer to the SOURCE PDF, not the post-delete one — easier to reason about.

page.description: 1-based page number in the SOURCE PDF (pre-delete).

name: pages
title: Edit pages (rotate / delete / reorder)
